name: Rule-Based
title: Rule-Based Authentication Template
summary: Computes a risk score for each login from configurable, weighted rules, then lets the login complete, prompts 2FA, or denies the login based on the score.
preRequisites: Modify the 1st and 2nd factor authentication option(s) from defaults as required.

Change the parameters at the top of the script as needed to match the requirements. Enable or disable each rule in riskRules, and set its weight and the values it checks. Use whole numbers for weights, thresholds and other numeric values.
Set stepUpThreshold and denyThreshold. A login whose risk score reaches stepUpThreshold is prompted 2FA, and one that reaches denyThreshold is denied.
The ipBased rule is enabled by default. Change its corpNetwork parameter to the IPv4 ranges of your network, or every login is treated as coming from outside.

The ipBased rule uses the client IP, taken from the X-Forwarded-For header when it is present. Make sure your load balancers and proxies set that header, so clients cannot send a trusted IP themselves.
The loginAttemptsBased rule needs Login Attempts Security to be enabled, as the failed attempt count is only maintained when it is.
The roleBased rule only checks roles that are associated with the application.
For the tenantBased rule: Service provider should be registered as a SAAS Application.
The siftRiskScore rule needs the Sift connector to be installed and the Sift API key to be added in the Console. To let Sift learn from failed logins, enable login events under Fraud Detection.
For the elkRiskBased rule: Change elasticsearch domain with the port.
The siftRiskScore and elkRiskBased rules call an external service during each login, which adds its response time to the login.

parametersDescription.stepUpThreshold: Risk score at or above which the 2nd factor is prompted.
parametersDescription.denyThreshold: Risk score at or above which the login is denied.
parametersDescription.errorMessage: Message shown when a login is denied.
parametersDescription.riskRules: The rules used to compute the risk score. Each rule has 'enabled', 'weight' (added to the risk score when the rule is triggered) and the values it checks.
parametersDescription.riskRules.ipBased: IP-Based: triggered when the login comes from outside the 'corpNetwork' IPv4 ranges, such as '10.100.0.0/16'. An entry without a mask is a single address. IPv6 addresses are always treated as outside.
parametersDescription.riskRules.newDeviceBased: New-Device-Based: triggered when the login comes from a device not yet verified with the 2nd factor. The device is remembered for 'deviceRememberPeriod' seconds using the 'cookieName' cookie.
parametersDescription.riskRules.loginAttemptsBased: Login-Attempts-Based: triggered when the user has made 'invalidAttemptsToStepup' invalid login attempts continuously.
parametersDescription.riskRules.roleBased: Role-Based: triggered when the user has any of the 'rolesToStepUp'.
parametersDescription.riskRules.groupBased: Group-Based: triggered when the user belongs to any of the 'groupsToStepUp'.
parametersDescription.riskRules.tenantBased: Tenant-Based: triggered when the user is in any of the 'tenantsToStepUp'.
parametersDescription.riskRules.userStoreBased: User Store-Based: triggered when the user is in any of the 'userStoresToStepUp'.
parametersDescription.riskRules.activeSessions: Triggered when the user already has more than 'allowedActiveSessions' active sessions. A session that the login reuses through single sign-on is counted too.
parametersDescription.riskRules.siftRiskScore: Triggered when the risk score (0 to 1) that Sift returns is above 'riskThreshold', given as a percentage (50 for 0.5). 'addWeightOnFailure' controls whether the weight is also added when the score cannot be retrieved.
parametersDescription.riskRules.elkRiskBased: ELK-Risk-Based: triggered when the risk score calculated from ELK is above 0. 'addWeightOnFailure' controls whether the weight is also added when ELK cannot be called.
